_comment: OpenClaw cron descriptor for the daily Almanac generator. Register this job by adding it to the workspace automations registry (memory/automations/latest-manifest.json) or by running the automation indexer after placing a copy of this file in memory/automations/almanac-generator.json.
name: Daily Almanac Generator
description: Generates the next day's Almanac edition — sources quotes and the 'You' chart from workspace manifests, validates against the DailyData schema, and writes the immutable snapshot to alphalpha:almanac:edition:{date} in KV.
summary: Phase 1: writes quotes + 'You' chart from workspace; all other tiles fall back to fixture. Phase 2+ tiles (article, look, venture, surprise) ship in later phases.
